'''Brakar''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He wielded an orange-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and used the [[Form IV/Legends|Ataru]] form of [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]]. He was sent to the [[House Traders' Circle]] to receive a stolen [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] that [[House of Thul|House Thul]] was selling to the Empire, but was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces who intercepted and recovered the holocron.
